News

There are lots of ways you can stay up-to-date with what's happening at Taupō District Council:

  • Check out our latest news articles below
  • Subscribe to our Connect e-newsletter to get a weekly wrap of the latest council and community news
  • Follow us on Facebook and Instagram
  • Download the Antenno app to get council notifications sent directly to your phone
  • Check any Alerts in place for things like road closures, road works, water restrictions and more
  • Have your say on any public consultations open for submissions
  • Watch council meetings live or on-demand on our YouTube channel

  • Taupō District Council to investigate four options for reform

    Date:
    2 Jul 2026, 3:00 pm
    Categories:
    News

    Taupō District Council will do a deep dive into four different options for local government reform before it decides whether to submit an amalgamation proposal to Central Government.

  • Taupō District Council adopts its Annual Plan

    Date:
    30 Jun 2026, 5:00 pm
    Categories:
    News

    Taupō District Council has today adopted its Annual Plan for the 2026/27 year.

  • Finish line in sight on Hawai Reserve

    Date:
    29 Jun 2026, 9:30 am
    Categories:
    News

    The project to install stormwater bunds on Hawai Reserve is nearly done!

  • Community concerned about timeframe for local government reform

    Date:
    26 Jun 2026, 3:30 pm
    Categories:
    News

    A community survey on local government reform has found many respondents are unsure about the Government’s reasons for reform and concerned about the tight timeframe to submit amalgamation proposals.

  • Award for innovative collaboration to solve housing shortage

    Date:
    26 Jun 2026, 2:00 pm
    Categories:
    News

    Local consortium recognised at 2026 LGFA Taituarā Local Government Excellence Awards when Taupō District Council won the Morrison Low Advisory Award for Excellence in Collaborating for Results.

  • Treat your dog to a mint-green registration tag

    Date:
    22 Jun 2026, 11:30 am
    Categories:
    News

    If you own a dog, make sure its registration is up to date before 1 July each year.

  • Good progress on Roberts/Tīitīraupenga intersection

    Date:
    22 Jun 2026, 10:00 am
    Categories:
    News

    Work is progressing well on safety improvements being made to the Roberts St/Tītīraupenga St intersection.

  • Independent report maintains Council's AA credit rating

    Date:
    18 Jun 2026, 2:10 pm
    Categories:
    News

    An independent assessment from financial ratings agency S&P Global has maintained Taupō District Council’s strong AA credit rating with a stable outlook.

  • Mangakino customer service centre and library temporarily closed

    Date:
    18 Jun 2026, 12:30 pm
    Categories:
    News

    The Mangakino customer service and visitor information centre and library is closed today and tomorrow for asbestos testing.

  • Matariki exhibition brings the life force of water to the surface

    Date:
    16 Jun 2026, 4:00 pm
    Categories:
    News

    Taupō Museum’s new exhibition Maiea – to surface explores the connection between people and their environment.

  • Have your say on local government reform

    Date:
    5 Jun 2026, 4:30 pm
    Categories:
    News

    ​Taupō District Mayor John Funnell says community input will be vital as councillors work to assess whether Taupō District Council should merge with another council, or councils.

  • Stormwater works and lane closure on Lake Terrace

    Date:
    28 May 2026, 11:00 am
    Categories:
    News

    Larger pipes are being installed along Lake Terrace to help improve the network’s ability to manage stormwater and reduce the risk of surface flooding in the area.

  • Stormwater works at Hawai Reserve

    Date:
    22 May 2026, 4:00 pm
    Categories:
    News

    Work is underway at Hawai Reserve to improve resilience to flooding during heavy rainfall events.

  • Paws and Pages returns to Taupō Library

    Date:
    14 May 2026, 10:30 am
    Categories:
    News

    Boost your child’s reading confidence with Paws and Pages at Taupō Library. Run by Canine Friends Pet Therapy New Zealand, these sessions offer a calm environment where kids can read stories to dogs.

  • New property valuations out this week

    Date:
    14 May 2026, 9:30 am
    Categories:
    News

    Every three years, we update property values across the Taupō District to help us distribute rates so that everybody pays their fair share based on up‑to‑date information.

  • Taupō District Council to investigate options for its future

    Date:
    11 May 2026, 5:00 pm
    Categories:
    News

    Despite concerns about the tight timeframe, Taupō District Council elected members will begin investigating whether the council should join a group of other councils to create a unitary authority.

  • New Omori Water Treatment Plant officially opened

    Date:
    8 May 2026, 4:00 pm
    Categories:
    News

    The new water treatment plant built to serve the Omori, Pukawa and Kuratau communities was officially opened yesterday, with around 40 members of the community and project team in attendance.

  • Free digital workshops at Taupō Library help locals stay safe online

    Date:
    5 May 2026, 4:00 pm
    Categories:
    News

    Taupō residents can build their digital confidence through a series of free digital workshops running every Thursday throughout May at Taupō Library.

  • Taupo District Council launch new venue booking platform

    Date:
    1 May 2026, 3:30 pm
    Categories:
    News

    Taupō District Council has launched Bookable, a new online platform that makes it easier to explore council venues and submit booking requests in one place.

  • Join us at a Councillor Connect Forum near you

    Date:
    1 May 2026, 11:30 am
    Categories:
    News

    The first Councillor Connect Forum is on Tuesday and we’d love you to be part of it.
